'''Nathan Cardamone Let the Wookie Agents Win Cause They Get No Love''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Nathan Cardamone]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-15078">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/15078 Let the Wookie Agents Win      Cause They Get No Love], DeckTech (Nathan "Xavier Six" Cardamone, 6 April 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/15078/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/15078/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Nathan Cardamone]]
* '''Published:''' 6 April 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Let the Wookie Agents Win      Cause They Get No Love''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents In The Court / No Love For The Empire|JPSD-L-agentsinthecourt.gif|label=Agents In The Court}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 Court Cardamone LS 2001 DeckTech.txt |Download]] (omits Staging Areas(or Ounee Ta), DB 97: not in GEMP)
* '''Strategy:''' Once again, another theme deck thats just plain fun. I've played this deck around a bit and it does surprisingly well even against monsters like Hunt Down. That and wookies are just cool.

== Original post ==

'''Let the Wookie Agents Win      Cause They Get No Love'''
* '''Author:''' Nathan "Xavier Six" Cardamone
* '''Published:''' April 6, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' Once again, another theme deck thats just plain fun. I've played this deck around a bit and it does surprisingly well even against monsters like Hunt Down. That and wookies are just cool.

=== Strategy ===

As stated this deck fun to play and everybody is always suprised by the Rep choice. The strategy is pretty obvious. Use the wookies, monks, and few mains to flip then over power the enemy with high power and multiple destinies. In the last version of this I played I had Corran Horn. I took him out for Chewie's Bow.

This deck runs on a theme and is highly alterable. There is not really anything in the deck that can't be exchange for something else. Experiment... find what work for you. Believe me nothing is cooler than seeing Vader or Mara go down fighting against your wookies. It's also great when you get to use Chewie's Bowcaster to knock out the Emperor.

If you play conservatively you really can hold your own against most decks. Just play it safe and beware of DLOTS.

Stupid computer... didn't mean to have this posted twice.
